notes: Dark Bento uses eight project concept covers and three full-image utility widgets in one blue and lilac illustration style. All eleven are encoded as WebP quality 84. assets.prompt: Create one wide standalone 16:9 editorial portfolio cover. Use case: stylized-concept. Attached reference establishes the dark Bento blue and lilac art family only; output only this single project concept artwork, with no website layout, controls, labels or screenshot. Project concept: A precise cobalt orbital ribbon loops around a small silver sphere and three blue translucent memory cards, visually evoking a personal AI workspace that remembers. Elegant broad elliptical orbit that reads as a thumbnail. Compose in the center 72% with generous safe breathing room, subject legible in both large card and small thumbnail crops. Style is carefully composed modern 2D layered editorial illustration with precise graphic edges and depth from overlapping gradient planes, faint refracted highlights and occasional thin detail strokes. No photorealistic 3D rendering. Strong deliberate silhouette, spare visual hierarchy, smooth but limited icy gradients, no noisy details. Palette unified to near-black indigo #131625 at perimeter, midnight blue and soft lilac fill, cobalt #557fff and pale icy blue #c6d9ff, only the subject-specific muted accent. Quiet art-directed background with two large layered gradated translucent planes, no visual clutter, no full-frame radiant wash. No words, lettering, watermark, frame, captions or interface controls. Render exactly one finished illustration filling the image to its edges.

Generate one standalone illustration bitmap to fill a portfolio tile. Use case: stylized-concept. Attached image is an art-direction reference only; recreate only the concept of the stack widget as its own full-bleed illustration. Square 1:1 canvas, subject centered in the upper half. Subject: A scene of three distinct rounded application panels hovering just above each other, diagonally staggered, cool blue and lilac glass edges, each panel clear and large. Underneath, very quiet traces on dark blue technical material. Reserve the bottom 24% mostly as uninterrupted dark negative space for external overlay text. Palette: dark charcoal navy #131625 at the edges and below, blue #527fff, frosted ice #c1d6ff, lilac #9f91e8. In the approved reference the highlights are translucent; reinterpret this as refined 2D layered graphic art: simple clean vector-like planes, deliberate graduated color fills, restrained low-contrast halo, fine pale-blue highlights and light paper-like detail. Create depth via overlaps and gradients, never a shiny photoreal 3D render, no synthetic bevel overload. Subtle but sufficiently bright for a dark website. Full bleed dark navy perimeter. No lettering, no words, no labels, no numbers, no UI panel frame/border, no arrows, no mockup layout, no title, no watermark. Exactly one clean illustration.
